allow_instructions: Shell commands that only run the repo test suite, a single test file, lint, typecheck, format-check, or skillsync tools under .cursor/vendor/skillsync/tools/ (run-verification, re-break, validate-state, tdd-audit, preflight-local) may run without asking.
Read-only git commands (status, diff, log, show, rev-parse, branch) and normal local git writes (add, commit, checkout, switch, stash, pull, fetch) may run without asking when cwd is this repo.
Editing source and test files under the project tree for the active RED→GREEN cycle may proceed without asking.
Paseo MCP tools used to orchestrate the Remaining loop may run without asking.
block_instructions: Any command that reads or writes .env, credentials, secrets, or SSH keys must ask for approval.
git push --force, git reset --hard, and production deploys must ask for approval.
Installing global packages or changing Cursor/Paseo user config outside the repo must ask for approval.
